description: Remove persona strip ('Follow a Journey') from GuidesLibraryView — it belongs exclusively in the Journeys tab
steps: Open components/guides/guides-library-view.tsx
Delete the entire `<section>` block that renders the persona grid (the one with label 'Follow a journey', 'Browse all →' link, and the PERSONAS.map grid)
Delete the PERSONAS import from the top of the file if it is no longer used elsewhere in the component
Verify the Library tab renders with no persona photos and no 'Follow a journey' label
Verify the Journeys tab (/guides/journeys) is completely unaffected

description: Fix sidebar topic buttons — replace bookmark progress bar and saved/total count with a plain guide count per topic
steps: Open components/guides/guides-library-view.tsx
In the `renderLibraryFilters` function, locate the per-topic button block inside GUIDE_TOPICS.map
Remove the `<div className='mt-2.5 flex items-center gap-3'>` block that contains the progress bar div and the `{saved}/{total}` span

Replace it with a single `<span>` showing `{total} guides` in `text-xs tabular-nums text-minuri-slate` placed inside the existing `<div className='flex items-center gap-2.5'>` after the topic name span
The `topicStats` map still computes saved+total; only the saved value is no longer rendered — do NOT remove topicStats computation
Verify sidebar shows topic icon + name + plain count (e.g. '7 guides') with no progress bar
Verify mobile filter sheet shows the same change

description: Derive `topicPickerVisible` boolean — true when no topic filter and no search query are active (library mode only)
steps: Open components/guides/guides-library-view.tsx
After the existing `const isBookmarksMode = mode === 'bookmarks'` line, add: `const topicPickerVisible = !isBookmarksMode && activeTopicFilter === 'all' && !rawQuery`
This derivation uses only existing variables — no new state or URL params needed
Verify the value is true on /guides with no params, false on /guides?topic=food-eating, false on /guides?q=myki

description: Build topic picker card grid (State A) — five large topic entry cards shown when topicPickerVisible is true
steps: Open components/guides/guides-library-view.tsx
Create a `topicPickerGrid` const (JSX) above the return statement
Render `<section className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3'>` containing GUIDE_TOPICS.map
Each card is a `<button type='button'>` with onClick calling `updateParams(params => params.set('topic', topic.slug))`
Card className: `flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-[1.5rem] border border-minuri-silver/60 bg-minuri-white p-6 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-minuri-fog`

Card contents: (1) Icon row — `
` with the topic's LucideIcon at size-5 text-minuri-teal; (2) Topic name — `

{topic.name}

`; (3) Count — `

{topicStats.get(topic.slug)?.total ?? 0} guides

`
Use the existing TOPIC_ICONS map for the icon lookup

In the main return, inside the library (non-bookmarks) branch, replace the current `<div className='min-w-0 space-y-8 ...'>` children with: `{topicPickerVisible ? topicPickerGrid : (<>{storyContextBanner}{guideSearchField}{guidesListBody}</>)}`
Verify: /guides with no params shows five topic cards; clicking a card navigates to guide list for that topic

description: Add breadcrumb back chip (State B) — 'All topics' button above the guide list that clears the topic filter
steps: Open components/guides/guides-library-view.tsx
Create a `topicBreadcrumb` const: a `<button type='button'>` rendered only when `!topicPickerVisible && !isBookmarksMode && activeTopicFilter !== 'all'`
Button onClick: `updateParams(params => params.delete('topic'))`
Button className: `inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-minuri-teal hover:text-minuri-ocean transition-colors`
Button contents: `<ArrowLeft className='size-3.5' aria-hidden />` + text `All topics`
ArrowLeft is already imported at the top of the file
Render `topicBreadcrumb` as the first child inside the State B branch (before storyContextBanner)
Verify: chip appears when a topic is active, clicking it returns to topic picker, chip is absent when no topic is selected

description: Hide sidebar in State A (topic picker) — sidebar should only show when guide list is visible
steps: Open components/guides/guides-library-view.tsx
Locate the `librarySidebar` const
Wrap the `<motion.aside>` in a conditional: only render when `!topicPickerVisible`
Change: `const librarySidebar = !isBookmarksMode ? (<motion.aside>...</motion.aside>) : null`
To: `const librarySidebar = !isBookmarksMode && !topicPickerVisible ? (<motion.aside>...</motion.aside>) : null`
Verify: sidebar is absent on /guides (no params), present on /guides?topic=food-eating
Verify: mobile filter button (libraryHeaderFiltersButton) is similarly hidden in State A by applying the same `&& !topicPickerVisible` guard to that const
